style: Avant-garde art-rock and theatrical avant-funk. Harmony: polyharmonic suspension fields with quartal voicings, unresolved upper partials, and shifting modal drone centers. Melody: fast clipped consonant runs, alveolar trills, trautonium glides, and clavioline counterpoint. Rhythm: 3:2 cross-rhythm coupling, double-time hallucination, metric collision, and continuous forward motion. Timbre: convolution resonators, fax machine handshakes, dial-up modems, tape echo units, 8-bit pulse-wave synths, and cheap analog circuitry. Performance: breathless hype delivery mixed with bewilderment headspace. Production: dry separation stemminess, exposed windows, cassette saturation, high kinetic density, room reflections, transformer saturation, sub-bass pulse modulation, transient clipping, circuit-bent delay lines, and granular stutter automation. Industrial metallic clatter blended with frantic circuit-bent oscillations.
